Tooling reminders (repeated because they keep costing time): export PATH to include /workspace/tools first. This container has NO PDF text extraction -- use arxiv.org/html/<id> or datatracker.ietf.org's own HTML rendering instead of fetching PDFs. When a claim's text contains an apostrophe inside a bash single-quoted JSON string, close the quote, insert the escaped apostrophe as '"'"' , and reopen the quote.
